title: BP Energy Outlook 2018 edition (outlook to 2040)
scenario_note: First edition built on scenarios. bp describes most results with reference to ET 'for ease of exposition' and says this 'does not imply that the probability of this scenario is higher than the others'. Recorded as central with that caveat.

entries.subject: oil
entries.metric: global liquids demand (oil, biofuels and other liquids)
entries.quote: In the ET scenario, global demand for liquid fuels (oil, biofuels, and other liquid fuels) increases by around 13 Mb/d, reaching 109 Mb/d by 2040.

entries.subject: electric vehicles
entries.quote: In the ET scenario, there are nearly 190 million electric cars by 2035, higher than the base case in last year’s Outlook of 100 million.

entries.subject: electric vehicles
entries.quote: The stock of electric cars is projected to increase by a further 130 million in the subsequent five years, reaching around 320 million cars by 2040.
